title: 截图编辑模式必须绑定当前视觉基线底图
prompt: 当前 visual_baseline 参考图是 ref.png，但 prototype-board 的 screenshot_edit base_image 绑定到 other.png，readiness 必须阻断。

required_behaviors: readiness 校验 base_image 与当前 visual_baseline 参考图一致
base_image 不一致时截图编辑模式门槛失败
forbidden_behaviors: 只检查 generation_mode 是否存在
允许 screenshot_edit 使用旧截图或其他截图

contract_checks.contains: base_image 与 visual_baseline 参考图不一致
`--base-image` 默认绑定为 visual_baseline 参考图

command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); export PMW_HOME="$tmp/home" PMW_PROJECT_SLUG=edit-base-test; root="$PMW_HOME/projects/$PMW_PROJECT_SLUG"; mkdir -p "$root/runs" "$root/briefs"; brief="$root/briefs/current.md"; printf '# 产品设计简报：测试
产品简报版本：v2
确认状态：已对齐

## 核心价值判断
- 一句话判断：已确认。
## 数据 / 能力 / 约束与不可虚构项
- 不可虚构项：不得虚构。
' > "$brief"; printf '{"current_run_id":"r1","latest_run_id":"r1","latest_brief":"%s","latest_brief_version":"v2"}
' "$brief" > "$root/project.json"; printf '{"ts":"2099-01-01T00:00:00Z","event":"gate","run_id":"r1","status":"已对齐","title":"产品简报确认","summary":"用户确认"}
{"ts":"2099-01-01T00:00:01Z","event":"decision","run_id":"r1","status":"已确认","title":"方案方向确认","summary":"默认方向已批准"}
' > "$root/runs/r1.jsonl"; python3 - "$tmp/ref.png" "$tmp/other.png" <<'PY'
import struct, sys, zlib
for path in sys.argv[1:]:
    w,h=1179,2556
    raw=b''.join(b'\x00'+b'\xff\xff\xff'*w for _ in range(h))
    def chunk(t,d): return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
    open(path,'wb').write(b'\x89PNG
\x1a
'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,2,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw,1))+chunk(b'IEND',b''))
PY
bin/pmw-artifact add --kind browser_evidence --title 当前截图 --status 已采集 --source-skill pm-brief --path "$tmp/ref.png" --summary '当前截图 生产基线' --run r1 >/dev/null; bin/pmw-image-audit baseline --reference "$tmp/ref.png" --register --run r1 >/dev/null; bin/pmw-prototype-board add --scheme 方案A --screen 首屏 --brief-path "$brief" --brief-version v2 --goal 测试 --anti-metric 测试 --non-fiction 不得虚构 --canvas-mode physical_longboard --target-output-pixels '目标输出 1179 x >=2556' --generation-mode screenshot_edit --base-image "$tmp/other.png" --edit-scope '价格说明区' >/dev/null; bin/pmw-dashboard readiness --target prototype --details; rm -rf "$tmp"
contains: base_image 与 visual_baseline 参考图不一致
